The wood top has walnut veneer for a classic touch that helps this piece blend with your existing styles. 47.2"L x 23.6"W x 15.7"H Engineered wood with walnut veneer; dark painted metal legs Contemporary A convenient coffee table with simple style Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
